The Comité de Ética is an organization within the Universidad Técnica Federico Santa María that enforces the Code of Ethics and its Specific Complementary Norms (NECs) and determines sanctions for non-compliance.
The Universidad Técnica Federico Santa María requires all its employees to adhere to the Code of Ethics and its Specific Complementary Norms (NECs).
The Specific Complementary Norms (NECs) are included in the Code of Ethics as outlined in Article 4.
The Specific Complementary Norms (NECs) are referenced in Article 5 for the application of sanctions by the Comité de Ética.
Article 4 sets the stage for the inclusion of Specific Complementary Norms (NECs) which are further detailed in Article 5.
The threshold for exceptions to the Norma Específica Complementaria is based on Unidades de Fomento.
The Decret of Rectoría N° 22/93 is being replaced by the current Norma Específica Complementaria.
The Aprobación en Consejo Superior refers to the approval of the Norma Específica Complementaria in the Consejo Superior meeting on July 12, 2007.
Decreto de Rectoría N°032/2007 rectifies and complements the Internal Regulation on Order, Hygiene, and Safety based on the regulations in the Estatuto de la Universidad.
